status: PROPOSED successor profile, builder-prepared. NOT adopted, NOT qualified, NOT an acceptance and NOT a release decision. It SUPPLEMENTS and does not replace, edit or overwrite environment-profile.proposed.v1.json (the original restricted-host profile with its Yama requirement) or any of its history; the original profile and its INCOMPLETE NC4 host requirements stay in force until the operator approves a scope change AND the independent Qualification owner approves this profile, before any acceptance run.
approval_required: operator approval of the scope change (no Yama host will be provisioned)
independent Qualification owner approval of this profile (identity recorded in the Qualification repository, see owner-designation-request.proposed.md)
claim: Under this profile the host-isolation claim is the narrower: a separately identified unprivileged client uid cannot reach the designated ingress's authority, state or effects except through the allowlisted IPC socket, on a trusted host. It makes no successor-qualification statement.
excluded_adversaries: an adversary running as the same uid as the ingress
any code running as the ingress uid
tampering with the trusted Python installation (interpreter, standard library, site-packages)

retained_requirements.distinct_uids: ingress and client run as distinct uids; the client has no supplementary group except the IPC group
retained_requirements.non_root_ingress: the ingress process is not root and has no effective, permitted or inheritable capabilities
retained_requirements.ipc_group_and_permissions: socket mode 0660 owned by the ingress uid with the dedicated IPC group, in a separate setgid IPC directory (2751) that is not the state directory; state directory 0700 owned by the ingress uid
retained_requirements.peer_credential_allowlist: explicit SO_PEERCRED uid allowlist: the ingress is started by hub tools/mvp_ingress/launch.py with a mandatory --allow-uid equal to the client uid; NC4-04 observes it on the live process argv
retained_requirements.process_credentials_capabilities_dumpabi: real, effective and saved uid/gid, supplementary groups, capability sets and the dumpable flag of the ingress process are verified from /proc by the independently captured environment record (hub tools/mvp_env_record/capture_env_record.py, sha256 in the composite identity)
retained_requirements.standard_ptrace_restrictions: the relevant standard Linux ptrace restrictions are recorded as observed (PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 on the ingress, and the kernel.yama.ptrace_scope value when the kernel exposes it). A mandatory Yama requirement is NOT part of this profile: a recorded value below 1 is reported, not required, and the same-uid exclusion above is what makes that acceptable
retained_requirements.launcher_and_dependency_integrity: bound by the composite candidate identity (G-15): hub revision, git tree ids of tools/mvp_ingress and tools/mvp_env_record, launcher entry point, capture script sha256, registry catalogue digest, Python 3.13 and lock-file sha256, environment profile sha256; plus the candidate commitment sha256 supplied from outside the checkout
retained_requirements.negative_tests: unauthorized IPC access is tested and must be denied: an outsider uid that is neither the allowlisted client nor in the IPC group (socket mode/group denial), an allowlisted-group member that is not the allowlisted uid (peer-uid refusal), direct access to the state directory and database as the client (NC4-01/NC4-02)
retained_requirements.independently_captured_observations: owner-side observations are made as the ingress uid and the environment record is captured against the live process by the hub script, bound to the run by the gate envelope; builder self-reports are not evidence

not_established_by_source_review: Source review alone cannot establish deployed host isolation. Code-level launch isolation (NC4-03 source predicate, NC4-04 launch evidence) is a different layer from host isolation and is never aggregated into it.
incomplete_conditions: no environment with distinct ingress and client identities is available: the successor host-isolation claim is INCOMPLETE
no independently captured environment record for the run
any retained requirement above not observed

result_labels.host_isolation_under_successor_profile: INCOMPLETE until observed on an environment with distinct identities and independently adjudicated
